purpose: ADR-053/054/059 semantic development regression oracle; synthetic inputs only
authorship: Independent test-design role; expected outcomes set before prompt implementation
limitations: Mock provider output and policy-text assertions do not establish live-model semantic accuracy.
This is an exposed development set, not a blind benchmark or population error-rate estimate.
CLEAR confirms only that clarification is unnecessary; final whole-room interpretation and deterministic matching remain separate.
Broad afternoon availability is preserved without assigning new exact daypart boundaries in this oracle.

proposalContract.NEEDS_CHOICE: Exactly one question, exact nonempty source excerpt, and A/B complete proposedText values; preserve all unrelated conditions, alternatives, exclusions and preferences. Alternatives differ from each other and the original. Neither invents a private fact. Explicit acceptance is required.
proposalContract.NEEDS_EDIT: No prompt, sourceExcerpt or choices. Use when no pair of safe complete interpretations exists without inventing facts or silently dropping contradictory requirements.
proposalContract.CLEAR: No prompt, sourceExcerpt or choices. Do not normalize, rewrite or narrow the stored original.

cases.reason: The explicit afternoon qualifier scopes the same continuous range; do not ask whether its end is morning.

cases.rawText: 토요일은 오후 중 아무 때나 괜찮아요.
cases.reason: Intentional broad afternoon availability is not a missing personal fact or a demand for exact endpoints.

cases.rawText: 이번 검색 기간에는 날짜와 시간 모두 제한 없어요.
cases.reason: An explicit absence of restrictions must not create a compulsory precision question.

cases.rawText: 월요일과 수요일은 오후 6시에서 9시 사이, 일요일은 오후 내내 가능해요.
cases.reason: A concrete weekday range and a broad weekend range are both meaningful; neither requires a private boundary.

cases.rawText: 토요일 오후는 모두 괜찮지만 오후 3시부터 4시까지는 안 돼요.
cases.reason: Broad availability plus a definite exclusion is not a contradiction; preserve both.

cases.rawText: 화요일 오후 2~4시 또는 금요일 저녁 7~9시 가능하고, 되도록 금요일이 좋아요.
cases.reason: Two explicit alternatives and a soft preference do not require selecting a single alternative before submission.
Morning and afternoon ranges materially differ and the supplied text/context does not resolve them.
Wednesday's qualifier must not silently determine a separate Thursday alternative; the resolved Wednesday alternative must remain in both proposals.
safeProposals: 수요일 오전 9~11시 또는 목요일 오전 7~9시 가능해요.
수요일 오전 9~11시 또는 목요일 오후 7~9시 가능해요.

cases.reason: A definite Friday alternative does not erase the unresolved Tuesday alternative; do not infer Tuesday's meridiem from a later separate clause.
safeProposals: 화요일 오전 3시부터 5시까지 또는 금요일 오후 6시부터 8시까지 가능해요.
화요일 오후 3시부터 5시까지 또는 금요일 오후 6시부터 8시까지 가능해요.

cases.rawText: 수요일은 제 수업이 끝난 뒤부터만 가능해요.
cases.reason: The class end time is a necessary private fact with no supplied value. A/B times would invent facts; simply repeating the symbolic boundary does not resolve it.

cases.rawText: 토요일 오후 2~4시에만 가능해요. 같은 토요일 오후 2~4시에는 절대로 참석할 수 없어요. 둘 다 필수 조건이에요.
cases.reason: Explicit mutually inconsistent mandatory claims cannot be preserved in either complete interpretation; do not silently choose one or invent a correction.
